changes_since_previous_release.scope: WO-031: Windows/install hardening, bounded project discovery, operational telemetry, Control Center truthfulness, and stronger integration diagnostics.

dependency_security.source: Current authenticated GitHub Dependabot inventory with candidate-state reconciliation.

remaining_open.detail: pytest (pip, development-only; GHSA-6w46-j5rx-g56g / CVE-2025-71176); no runtime alert.

provenance.candidate_state_binding: SHA-256 hashes of requirements.txt, requirements-dev.txt and dashboard/package-lock.json plus parsed candidate package identities.

upgrade.canonical_state: PostgreSQL state and HIVE_DATA_ROOT are preserved; discovery uses existing registry and indexing structures and never deletes registry records or source data.
upgrade.backup_recommendation: Back up PostgreSQL and HIVE_DATA_ROOT and record the deployed revision before upgrade.

rollback.reason: No migration or schema change is introduced; discovery writes additive data using the existing registry, index and retrieval structures that v1.0.2 already understands.
rollback.restore: Keep PostgreSQL and HIVE_DATA_ROOT. A data restore is not normally required for schema compatibility; retain the pre-upgrade backup for operational recovery.

known_limitations: One open MODERATE pytest Dependabot alert remains development-only; zero applicable unresolved CRITICAL/HIGH alerts remain.
Optional provider metrics are not claimed EXACT without provider evidence; unknown values are not rendered as zero.
Deterministic embedding, reranking and token benchmarks prove contract mechanics, not production model quality.
No v1.0.3 publication request is included; publication authorization remains a separate future increment.
